title: False Victory
creativeIntent: Earth defenders celebrate after destroying the visible enemy wave, then a much larger force arrives and darkens the planet.

beats.storyClaim: The pilot destroys the final visible enemy wave.

actions.subject: friendly
actions.result: enemy ships visibly disappear after impact

camera.subject: friendly
camera.purpose: Keep attacker, targets and Earth readable in one action space.

beats.evidence: Unity shows several enemy ships, repeated attack/impact beats, and those targets are visibly gone by the end of the beat.

beats.storyClaim: The defenders believe the battle is over.

dialogue.speaker: pilot
dialogue.text: They're gone. We actually did it.

dialogue.speaker: commander
dialogue.text: Hold the channel. Confirm the board is clear.

camera.subject: pilot
camera.purpose: Show relief through legal dialogue presentation rather than narration alone.

beats.evidence: The enemy is already absent from the preceding battle state and the command presentation visibly changes to relief.

beats.storyClaim: A far larger enemy force arrives and casts a shadow over Earth.

actions.subject: giants
actions.result: giant ships become readable against Earth

actions.subject: earth
actions.result: Earth visibly darkens as the larger ships occupy the frame

camera.subject: giants
camera.purpose: Use Earth as a stable scale reference while revealing the new threat.

beats.evidence: Unity first establishes Earth, then reveals multiple much larger ships and a visibly motivated darkening of the planet.
